title: Moodle sync
description: Server-side academic sync: policies, per-student jobs, runs, accounts and the activity log.

list.name: job_type
list.label: Job type
list.query: SELECT job_type FROM sync_policies ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT job_type FROM sync_policies ORDER BY 1

list.name: log_source
list.label: Log source
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source FROM sync_log_entries ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT source FROM sync_log_entries ORDER BY 1

list.name: log_level
list.label: Log level
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT level FROM sync_log_entries ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT level FROM sync_log_entries ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "ok" FROM external_accounts WHERE credential_status = 'active'

panels.title: Re-login
panels.description: NTUST credentials that stopped working. Sync for these students is disabled until they sign in again in the app.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "invalid" FROM external_accounts WHERE credential_status <> 'active'
SELECT count(*) AS "pending" FROM sync_jobs j WHERE j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring}) AND j.status = 'pending'
SELECT count(*) AS "running" FROM sync_jobs j WHERE j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring}) AND j.status = 'running'

panels.title: Overdue
panels.description: Pending jobs more than 10 minutes past run_after, counting only types the worker would claim (policy enabled and inside its active window). The sync tick runs every 30 seconds, so these should be picked up long before.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "overdue"
FROM sync_jobs j
JOIN sync_policies p ON p.job_type = j.job_type
WHERE j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring}) AND j.status = 'pending' AND j.run_after < now() - interval '10 minutes'
  AND p.enabled AND (p.active_from IS NULL OR p.active_from <= now()) AND (p.active_until IS NULL OR p.active_until > now())

panels.title: Stuck
panels.description: Running for longer than the worker's stale-lock limit (TIGERDUCK_SYNC_JOB_STALE_LOCK_MINUTES, read from the backend).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "stuck" FROM sync_jobs j WHERE j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring}) AND j.status = 'running' AND j.locked_at < now() - make_interval(secs => COALESCE(NULLIF('${sync_stale_lock}', '')::float, 600))

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Sync runs started in the dashboard's time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "runs" FROM sync_runs r JOIN sync_jobs j ON j.id = r.sync_job_id WHERE j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
SELECT count(*) AS "failed" FROM sync_runs r JOIN sync_jobs j ON j.id = r.sync_job_id WHERE j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.status = 'failed'

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.started_at, '1h', 0), r.status AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM sync_runs r JOIN sync_jobs j ON j.id = r.sync_job_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.started_at, '1h'),
       avg(extract(epoch FROM r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS "average",
       max(extract(epoch FROM r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS "longest"
FROM sync_runs r JOIN sync_jobs j ON j.id = r.sync_job_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Items fetched and changed per hour

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.started_at, '1h', 0),
       sum(r.fetched_count) AS "fetched", sum(r.changed_count) AS "changed"
FROM sync_runs r JOIN sync_jobs j ON j.id = r.sync_job_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT job_type AS "job type", enabled AS "enabled", default_interval_seconds AS "interval",
       active_from AS "active from", active_until AS "active until", priority AS "priority",
       max_attempts AS "max attempts", updated_at AS "updated"
FROM sync_policies
ORDER BY job_type

panels.title: Jobs
panels.description: One row per student and sync type. Running and failed first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(u.student_id, u.id::text) AS "student",
       j.job_type AS "job type",
       j.status AS "status",
       j.run_after AS "next run",
       j.last_success_at AS "last success",
       j.last_failure_at AS "last failure",
       j.attempts || '/' || j.max_attempts AS "attempts",
       j.locked_by AS "locked by",
       left(j.last_error, 200) AS "last error"
FROM sync_jobs j
JOIN users u ON u.id = j.user_id
WHERE j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(u.student_id, '') ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')
ORDER BY (j.status = 'running') DESC, (j.status = 'failed') DESC, j.run_after
LIMIT 500

SELECT r.started_at AS "started",
       COALESCE(u.student_id, u.id::text) AS "student",
       j.job_type AS "job type",
       extract(epoch FROM r.finished_at - r.started_at) AS "took",
       left(r.error, 300) AS "error"
FROM sync_runs r
JOIN sync_jobs j ON j.id = r.sync_job_id
JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id
WHERE r.status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(u.student_id, '') ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Failure reasons
panels.description: Failed runs in range, by error prefix.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT split_part(COALESCE(r.error, 'unknown'), ':', 1) AS "reason", count(*) AS "runs"
FROM sync_runs r JOIN sync_jobs j ON j.id = r.sync_job_id
WHERE r.status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(u.student_id, u.id::text) AS "student",
       a.provider AS "provider",
       a.credential_status AS "credential",
       a.last_auth_success_at AS "last sign-in ok",
       a.last_auth_failure_at AS "last sign-in failed",
       left(a.last_auth_error, 200) AS "error"
FROM external_accounts a
JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id
WHERE (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(u.student_id, '') ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')
ORDER BY (a.credential_status <> 'active') DESC, a.last_auth_failure_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 500

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(e.ts, '1h', 0), e.source AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM sync_log_entries e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND e.source IN (${log_source:sqlstring}) AND e.level IN (${log_level:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Activity log
panels.description: The per-user sync log (sync_log_entries) the apps and executor write. Newest first, 500 rows max.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time",
       COALESCE(u.student_id, e.user_id::text) AS "student",
       d.platform AS "device",
       e.level AS "level",
       e.source AS "source",
       e.message AS "message",
       left(e.detail::text, 300) AS "detail"
FROM sync_log_entries e
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = e.user_id
LEFT JOIN user_devices d ON d.id = e.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.source IN (${log_source:sqlstring})
  AND e.level IN (${log_level:sqlstring})
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(u.student_id, '') ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND (${message:sqlstring} = '' OR e.message ILIKE '%' || ${message:sqlstring} || '%')
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 500
